inputs.name: infix-safe
inputs.source:
---- MODULE Differential ----

VARIABLE x
left %% right == ~left
Init == x = FALSE
Next == x' = (x %% TRUE)
Safe == x \in BOOLEAN
====
inputs.config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
